title: Neapolitan Pizza Sauce

items: 28oz can of San Marzano tomatoes, whole

steps: Strain excess liquids into a medium pot through a mesh strainer and transfer the tomatoes and thick pulp to a bowl.
Add salt, basil, and olive oil to the bowl.
Reduce the tomato liquid in a pot over medium-low heat until it’s thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, then add to the bowl.
